periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique diagonal orientation, approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.4:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering with the lower terminus extending significantly below the horizontal ocular midline.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped posterior boundary with minimal central indentation.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Moderate separation, gap distance approximately 1.2 times the horizontal width of an individual pinna.

other_distinctive_markers: Irregular dark pigmentation patches on the lower lumbar and sacral regions.
